$Comment: Christmas Day, December 25th (both ends that one day, counted in UTC), inside Christmas. The file name is
the event id. It exists so content can wait for the day itself: MMO Skill Tree's boost rule
MMOSkillTree/BoostRules/SeasonsOfOrbis/Mmo_Christmas_Day.json reads it beside Christmas, so the boost
runs only while both are live. It has no Herald, so it comes and goes without a banner; Christmas
Morning's banner already greets the morning.
It is an event of its own, on its own dates: a server owner who moves Christmas in
mods/ziggfreedcommon/calendar.json moves this one there too. Switching Christmas off is enough to keep
